pubs.name: The Folly at Napton
pubs.desc: A canalside pub with real fires and a warm welcome. Food served daily, dog-friendly, and views over the Oxford Canal.

pubs.name: The Kings Head
pubs.desc: A Hook Norton house at the heart of the village. Traditional ales, quiz nights, and proper home cooking.

pubs.name: Napton Cidery
pubs.desc: Craft cider pressed from Napton's own orchards. Farm shop, tastings, and seasonal events throughout the year.

pubs.name: The Victory Club
pubs.desc: The village social club. Sport on the telly, live events, darts, and a community spirit you can't bottle.
